title: Paired Shade Open-Close Asymmetry
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=blindmotor:state
| stats avg(travel_time_sec) as avg_travel_time_sec by pair_id blind
| eventstats max(avg_travel_time_sec) as slowest_blind, min(avg_travel_time_sec) as fastest_blind by pair_id
| eval travel_gap=round(slowest_blind-fastest_blind,1)
| where travel_gap>4
| sort - travel_gap
description: Uses Paired blind motor telemetry telemetry to monitor timing mismatch between shades that should move together in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for paired blinds drifting far enough to be visually obvious, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Paired blind motor telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Pair table of slowest and fastest travel times.
grandmaExplanation: It produces timing mismatch between shades that should move together so you can spot paired blinds drifting far enough to be visually obvious before it becomes annoying.
